scope: Additive TH18 regular Lava Hound direct-parent baseline. Lava Pup remains a required but unmaterialized subunit until current values and a deterministic death-split contract are available.
game_version: The upstream payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. Supercell identifies Lava Hound level 8 as Town Hall 18 content, while the numerical parent table remains the pinned secondary payload.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.limitations: The release note establishes Lava Hound level 8 at Town Hall 18. It does not publish numeric parent values, target priority, death damage geometry, Lava Pup values, or a death-split lifecycle.

sources.title: Home Village Lava Hound structured troop record
sources.limitations: The pinned public payload supplies the L1-L8 parent values, direct attack cadence, range, movement, housing, flight and ground-only target type. Its death damage field has no published current radius, timing or target contract and cannot by itself activate an explosion.

sources.title: Lava Hound
sources.limitations: The current public page was reviewed for the Air Defense priority and Lava Pup relationship. It does not provide a version-pinned Lava Pup table, count, level mapping, timing, spawn coordinates, targeting or visual contract suitable for deterministic GameData.

target_focus.note: Core uses the shared staged Air Defense, remaining-defense, then ordinary-building priority. The source does not establish more detailed retarget ordering.

support.note: Core materializes the pinned L1-L8 flying parent baseline. Lava Pup splitting and the unspecific death-damage field remain disabled pending a reproducible child and explosion contract.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only L1-L8 parent inherited an any-target focus and had no Core identifier or adapter route.
changed_values.replacement: The source-backed L1-L8 flying parent materializes through the shared Core path with its documented Air Defense priority and published direct attack values.
changed_values.justification: The parent numerical table is pinned and Supercell confirms the TH18 level. The priority is public secondary evidence. Its missing death behaviors remain outside the baseline.

changed_values.previous_state: Not represented in the permanent spawned-subunit inventory.
changed_values.replacement: Recorded as a required but unmaterializable Lava Hound child in the scope inventory.
changed_values.justification: The public parent-child relationship is known, but current reproducible child values and deterministic split behavior are absent from the consulted sources.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source provides a current Lava Pup hitpoint, damage, cadence, range, speed, target type, housing, level mapping, count, death-split timing, spawn geometry, targeting, retargeting, lifetime, trap interaction or asset contract.

The parent numerical payload includes death damage but no current radius, delay, target eligibility, flight interaction or collision rule. Core does not activate this incomplete field as a generic explosion.
No consulted source publishes projectile launch, travel, collision or impact timing for the parent. Its one-tile direct attack remains a logical fixed-tick baseline, not a calibrated flight model.
Parent sprite source fidelity, scaling and animation remain unverified.
conclusion: Lava Hound L1-L8 is executable through the shared Core, Headless CLI, Viewer and RL path as a flying Air Defense-priority parent baseline. Lava Pup splitting, parent death damage geometry, projectile timing and visual fidelity remain explicitly partial.
